slice: PR 1 of 2: buoyancy physics in the core model, replayed against a legacy recording; save v5
command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run license-check && npm run sites:check && npm run devcontainer:check && npm run build && npm run dist:check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:parity && npm run pixi:visual-check && npm run interior:check && npx playwright test
workingTree: clean before the run and still clean after it
timestampProvenance: Both are `date -u` output printed around the run.
provenanceNote: The full run above is on 8c42fed. The only later commit updates this file, so src, tests and scripts are identical to the measured tree (see durableProvenance).
earlierRuns: A first full run on a22b0ce, the same change before an amend, failed 2 Playwright tests in tests/in-dive-controls.spec.js that pinned the save at version 4 (expected 4, received 5). They now assert the version they rely on: at least v3 for the dive mode, at least v4 for CNS. Both passed alone (14 of 14 in the gas information group) and in the full run above.

A full run on 7692e30 passed (298 unit, 56 parity, 139 e2e). The pre-review of #193, pass 1, then found that inflating from a diluent holding less than one step's draw could throw (p - (p * v) / v one ulp below zero). 8c42fed fixes it and adds a unit test that throws a RangeError without the fix; the run above is on that commit.

results.distCheck: pass: 17 files scanned, no source maps, 4 diagnostic markers absent
results.unit: 299 passed (286 on main, +9 in tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts, +4 in tests/unit/save-game.test.ts)
results.parity: 56 passed (49 on main, +2 in tests/parity/buoyancy.test.ts, +5 planner checkpoints the new scenario adds to tests/parity/dive-planner.test.ts)

parity.recording: scripts/baseline-scenarios.cjs: rec setup, shore site swapped to the geometry-free 'open' site, one air cylinder, neutralizeAt(12) at rest. Then S held 4 s, nothing 20 s, W held 11 s, nothing 30 s, in one-second ticks through legacy's updateDiving(), so updateBuoyancyPhysics() moves the diver and nothing sets the depth.

checkpoints.inflated-11s: depth 22.575, velocity 2.905 (turned by the inflation, below both limits), BCD 13.892 L
checkpoints.coasting-30s: depth 15.974, velocity -25 (the ascent limit, reached as the BCD expands)

parity.compared: Depth after each of the 65 ticks; velocity, BCD gas, CNS, cylinder gas and the 16 N2 compartments at each checkpoint. Tolerances are the fixture's own absoluteEpsilon.
parity.noFailure: Legacy does not end the dive in the recording, and the model's failure stays null throughout.

fixtureRegeneration.legacyChange: src/game-loop.js captureBaselineCheckpoint() gains state.bcdGasSurface_l, an additive field as docs/decisions.md 'Trace contract limits' allows.
fixtureRegeneration.additiveCheck: The fixture at 0c9701a (before) and at 7692e30 (after) were compared scenario by scenario with bcdGasSurface_l stripped. air-18m-30min, trimix-45m-20min, ccr-30m-30min, ccr-bailout-30m, ccr-setpoint-bailout-30m and tec-switch-21m are identical. Every one of their checkpoints carries the new field. The header differs only in referenceCommit.

counterChecks.method: Each revert was applied to src/core/buoyancy.ts from a backup copy, tests/parity/buoyancy.test.ts and tests/unit/buoyancy.test.ts were run (10 tests), then the file was restored from the backup. The working tree was clean afterwards apart from this evidence file. Run on 7692e30; the fix in 8c42fed changes only the diluent draw, which the recording (open circuit) does not reach.
